answer: The hollow schedule is applied in mesa and knoll shows each instalment. A payout is split thus 45% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An copycat therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4505 identities would post 3745 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
